items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: I think he recorded a little bit with Piron.

ctx.x: Well, he always had his clarinet alongside him. And there were certain passages that I couldn't finger. He showed me how to finger that particular passage. He showed me which keys to press down.

Nobody seems to ever talk much about his style since he was quite early and didn't do much recording. I think he recorded a little bit with Piron. One of two sides. But what style did he play? What style did he play? Was it more like Noon or? More like Noon. More like than Dodds, I guess.
More so like Noon than Dodds.
